summary: Cred analyzes BTC trading in a range with monthly support at 35-37k and resistance at 58k. The market is currently testing 44k for the fifth time. Key focus is on 47-48k area where multiple HTF moving averages converge - this represents the major decision point. If BTC accepts above this level, it could flip bearish trend to temporarily bullish and move toward 58k. Range-bound behavior continues until breakout is confirmed.
